provenance.incident_window: Dataset description (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20001206, Organization Y): successful privilege escalation on 2025-04-29 from 05:28 to 07:07 local time. The last rule-labelled post-compromise command is at 07:08:46, so the end is set to 07:10:00.
provenance.timezone_assumption: The description says 'local time' and syslog has no zone. UTC is assumed: the first successful root login (05:34:30) and the first rule-labelled post-compromise command (06:09:07) then fall inside the documented window. Not proven.
provenance.single_incident: Only one incident exists in this slice. It supports a zero-shot evaluation of unsupervised and rule detectors; it cannot train or calibrate a supervised model for incident detection.
provenance.splits: Time-ordered. baseline: fit the baseline only (not scored). train: fit unsupervised models on background windows. validation: pick thresholds / alert budget from background windows (no incident labels exist here). gap: excluded. test: contains the incident and what follows it.
